items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: That was Judge LeBlanc. And I think he had no legs on the last, after a while I heard he had lost his legs. He's dead now, I know.

ctx.x: That was Judge LeBlanc. And I think he had no legs on the last, after a while I heard he had lost his legs. He's dead now, I know.
